10993 lásati ¹ 'flashes, shines' MBh., 'sports' Chandom. [√ las ¹] Pa. lasati 'shines, sports', Pk. lasaï , lhasaï ; OAw. lasaï 'shines, looks beautiful'; H. lasnā 'to shine, look
well, befit'; G. lasvũ , lasāvũ 'to look beautiful, play'; — ext. - kk -: S. lahakaṇu 'to flare up, be kindled'; H. lasaknā 'to shine, become' (→ L. lask f. 'flashing'?), lahaknā 'to shine' (← NW?).
